title: SignalOS: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe SignalOS loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Read drive labels, preserve unknown records, and install drives only where the terminal or rack expects them. Keep a clean backup when possible.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A good SignalOS start is preserving unknown drives, reading labels, and installing data only where the terminal or rack expects that role.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves SignalOS is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
